answer: A payout is split so that 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The basalt schedule is applied in ivory and orchard exposes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1523 identities would post 1949 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
